title: Image
lead: An image displays graphical content such as a photo or illustration.

examples.name: Shape
examples.description: Images can be styled as square (default), circular, or with rounded corners.

examples.name: Bordered
examples.description: The `bordered` prop will apply a border style to images regardless of its shape.

examples.name: Fallback
examples.description: In cases when images fail to load, the Image component will result into the native `<img/>` browser fallback.

examples.name: Block
examples.description: An Image can be maximized in order to fill its parent container.

examples.name: Fit
examples.description:
The `fit` prop is used to determine how the image should be resized in order to fit its container.

The image can be resized in various ways: centering to its container(`center`),
         filling its container (`cover`) or preserving the aspect ratio (`contain`).

examples.name: Shadow
examples.description: The shadow prop will apply box shadow styling to the image.

prose.text:
## Best practices

### Do

- Provide descriptive, accurate and concise description for `alt` attribute in order to be accessible to screen readers.
- The `alt` description should also include and consider the context where the image fits in.
- Decorative images should be excluded for assistive tools, thus adding `role="presentation"` or `aria-hidden="true"`.

### Don't

- Don't include "image of", "picture of" etc. in the `alt` attribute since it is redundant.
- Don't repeat the same information that is already on the page on the `alt` attribute.
